<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a writing resource, that can be made by combining [[black paint]], [[water]], and [[conical flasks]] in the church workbench and requires the Writing Supplies [[technology]].  Alternatively it can be purchased from the [[Astrologer]] for {{Money|150}}.  A bottle of ink is required to complete [[Vagner]] the Actor's request for writing supplies so that he can write a poem to [[Ms. Charm]].  For each bottle of ink it's possible to craft 3x [[pen and ink]] which are used for writing.
